warnings: Axes: x = 1-2 (4.00, one bay); y = A-C (4.00 each). Origin A1. Every line is printed on the S sheets — nothing scaled.
C'' (9.00) carries two printed meanings that land on the same position: the F2A north edge (S-02) and the roof eave 1.00 below C (S-05). Kept as one line.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget for this batch) — z_levels holds only the ground datum printed on the S sheets.
